items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1973-09-07
items.q: I was with the Franz Jackson band. She was playing piano with us.

ctx.x: You weren't a bad boy or anything? Oh no, no.

I'd never been to drugs, that's good. I'd never been to trouble. The only time I would have been in trouble, if you may recall, they put us all in jail in Memphis, the whole band. See we played, we did six weeks and when we left, see it was supposed to be a big dance here at the end of this game out there. And it's supposed to have some government warehouse or something like that. items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1958-06-02
items.q: Later on I played, the little band we had together, we played at the reception for Lil and Louis at the wedding reception.

ctx.x: Well when did you leave about?

In 1917. I arrived in Chicago January the 3rd, 1917. I was thirteen years old. And it wasn't long before I began to hear them talking about Louis Armstrong. My, at the time it was Joe Oliver. I'd seen them fellas bucking one another, him and Mutt. René, I hadn't heard of René. And I hadn't heard of Louis because I saw Louis.
